text: Backend: stop writing idea files from the read path
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). server.ts readIdea migrates legacy fields (outgoing -> supportedIdeas) and replaces [0,0] relativePositions with random ones, writing the file back — during every idea.get/idea.list. Reads therefore mutate the repo (noisy .bowman diffs, races with concurrent writers/agents, nondeterministic positions). Move these migrations into an explicit, idempotent migration step (project open / fix_consistency) and make readIdea pure.

status.comment: readIdea is pure: normalizeIdeaRecord upgrades incoming/outgoing in memory only. [0,0] (schema-default) connection positions are now placed in writeIdea, where writes happen anyway. migrateIdeaFiles persists legacy upgrades explicitly and runs first in project.fixConsistency (reported as 'Upgraded ...' fixes).

reflection: Verified: backend vitest 75/75 incl. new test asserting idea.get + idea.list leave a [0,0]-linked idea file byte-identical and fixConsistency places it; legacy incoming/outgoing tests now assert the file is untouched by reads and upgraded by fixConsistency. tsc clean. Scan of .query procedures found no other idea writes. Found the same read-writes pattern for phases (readPhaseFile reconcile + silent writePhase) — filed as a separate idea.
